subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial report request, bridge-note options, and evidence checklist

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>

Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial report request, bridge-note options, and evidence checklist

Hi Liam —

Hope you're well. We're starting a security intake for an upcoming customer audit and would like to request Acme's most recent SOC 2 Type II report and any accompanying bridge letter(s) that cover the audit period. A few specifics to help us ingest the package quickly: 

- Audit period we need coverage for: 2025-05-01 ➜ 2026-04-30 (please confirm actual period on your report).
- Preferred items to share: PDF of the SOC 2 Type II report (report + auditor's opinion), any bridge letter(s) or coverage statement, system description / boundary document, and an assertion (if separate).
- Preferred transfer methods: secure Box/ShareFile link, SFTP upload, or an encrypted email with separate delivery of password. (We can provide an upload token if easier.)

I've attached a short checklist (redwood-soc2-evidence-request.xlsx) and two one-line/short-note templates in case your legal/compliance team prefers copy/paste responses. For convenience, two sample templates are below — feel free to send either a full report or a bridge note if the full Type II PDF is not yet available.

Template A — Short bridge note (one paragraph):
"Acme Corp confirms that the SOC 2 Type II report issued for the period MM/DD/YYYY to MM/DD/YYYY remains representative of our controls and that there have been no material changes affecting the scope of the report as of [date]."

Template B — Full report delivery note (brief):
"Attached: Acme Corp SOC 2 Type II report (period MM/DD/YYYY–MM/DD/YYYY). Also included: system description and assertion. Contact security@acmecorp.com for access issues"

Can you confirm whether you'll share a full Type II PDF or a bridge note, and an ETA for delivery? Ideally we get something by EOD Aug 13 given our intake window, but if you need more time let us know and we'll coordinate.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
